name: frijolito-receipts
description: Notarize moments and verify signed, tamper-evident Frijolito receipts. Verification is free and needs no key.

api_key.title: Frijolito API key
api_key.description: Only needed to notarize. Verifying receipts works without a key. Request one from concierge@frijolito.app (fj_test_… or fj_live_…).

allow_live.title: Allow production receipts
allow_live.description: Turn on to let an fj_live_ key mint production receipts. Leave off while testing.
